name: astro-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for solo hobby projects.

plugins.name: global-memory
plugins.description: Memories Claude writes for every project, kept in ~/.claude/memory and loaded into each session, and /global-memory, a menu to browse, read and delete them.

plugins.name: bug-hunt
plugins.description: /bug-hunt:hunt finds bugs and reproduces each one before calling it a bug: a whole codebase component by component, a path or area, or a change that Claude Code's /code-review reviews first.

plugins.name: project-md
plugins.description: Creates PROJECT.md, a committed file that describes a project's purpose and scope, and loads it into every session without an import in CLAUDE.md. Run /project-md:review at any time to compare recent work with the file. It changes the file only with your approval.

plugins.name: plain-english
plugins.description: Makes Claude write plain language as ISO 24495-1 defines it, in a professional, neutral tone, so readers can easily find, understand and use what it writes. An output style for the main conversation and forks, and the same instructions handed to every subagent.

plugins.name: instructions
plugins.description: /instructions:init sets up and reviews a project's CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md and your global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. A fork of Claude Code's new /init that checks each file against Claude Code's docs and prompt audit, and shows every draft before writing.
